takeaways: AI and Copilot projects succeed when organizations invest in change management, training and enablement alongside the technology.
Copilot works on your own data, so data quality, regular quality controls and a lasting data culture determine the value it delivers.
Internal champions or ambassadors, authentic leadership and a focused niche help people keep up with the fast pace of AI change.
hook: Many organizations buy Copilot licenses and expect instant productivity, only to be disappointed. In this conversation, Microsoft MVP Fabio Bonolo shares with IT professionals and business leaders why change management, data culture and empowering leadership matter more than the tool itself. You get practical tips on champions networks, staying up to date and leading people through AI-driven change.
